attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 18 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page. **The whole of the page's text is one sentence: «Δεν έχουμε λεπτομέρειες για τον βίο του Ρώσου Αγίου.»** That is a refusal to tell the life and not a refusal to vouch for the man: no asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου…». The years are in the head and are recorded. **`types` is empty: the page gives him no rank beyond «Άγιος» and says it knows nothing of his life.** Its related link names the synaxis of all the saints of Siberia, which was not read. It names Verkhoturye and no coordinate is proposed; it prints no hymn. The `russian` row is left `undocumented` although the page calls him a Russian saint, because days.pravoslavie.ru was not read. The corpus keeps a `john-of-verkhoturye` on 16 Απριλίου, who is not this man.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (2 October 2026).
